subject.title: perf(agents): cache provider tool schema normalization

question: Should provider tool-schema cache eligibility remain an internal bundled-compatibility implementation detail, or become a supported provider-plugin API?
rationale: The current branch adds a public callable despite describing the cache as internal and deliberately bypassing custom hooks; choosing a permanent external contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Move the cache classification behind an internal provider/agent boundary and retain the existing bundled-only behavior without adding a Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Adopt a provider contract
options.body: Approve and document an explicit cache-key hook for external provider plugins, including compatibility, invalidation, and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal
recommendation.body: Move the cache classification behind an internal provider/agent boundary and retain the existing bundled-only behavior without adding a Plugin SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked prepared-runtime tracking work owns the selected-provider runtime-handle boundary that this new cache API would extend.
